label: At D2, high when reaching S1, highest via rare a2->S1; lowest via rare a1->S2.
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * prev_reward
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 20. Timing explains 0.80 of variance (strongly elevated at D2). Beyond timing, the magnitude is set at D2 by the just-observed choice x reached state: S1 raises it (+0.05), the rare transition a2->S1 raises it much further (+0.13 more), and the rare transition a1->S2 lowers it (-0.14); common a2->S2 and a1->S1 sit near baseline. All terms are observed at D2 (action and state are inputs then). The free fit adds a smaller carry-over at D1 (and slightly GO) after the previous trial reached S2 (+0.05 at D1), a weak negative belief_lo term at D2, and negligible previous-reward effects; reward and hidden good state matter little.

issues: The recorded short form is a full 2x2 interaction (S1, S1*a2, S2*a1), but the effect at D2 is additive, not specific to rare transitions. (D2)*(state==S1) ;; (D2)*(action==1) scores the same test R^2 (0.7271 vs 0.7274), with weights S1 +0.19 and a1 -0.14. Adding (D2)*(common==0) gets weight -0.003 and adds 0.0000. So 'highest via rare a2->S1, lowest via rare a1->S2' is only an ordering that falls out of two main effects, and 'the two common transitions sit near baseline' only holds because the S1 and a1 effects roughly cancel. Nothing is special about rare transitions.
The residual table points the same way. D2 choice x state residuals: a1S1 +0.042, a1S2 -0.148, a2S1 +0.175, a2S2 -0.054. The implied interaction is about -0.01.

The short form's third term carries no information beyond the 2x2 cell coding. A slot is better spent on the D1 carry-over. Running misses on the recorded form shows a systematic D1 error: D1 after a previous S2 trial is under-predicted (a1 S2 r +0.066, a2 S2 r +0.045, a1 S2 u +0.040), and D1 after a previous S1 trial is over-predicted (-0.034).

Better short form: (D2)*(state==S1) ;; (D2)*(action==1) ;; (D1)*(prev_state==S2). It scores test R^2 beyond timing 0.807 (0.810 on dev), against 0.727 for the recorded form. After this fix the remaining misses are all under 0.035.
Minor: written alone, (D2)*(action==2) fails (0.002, and it adds nothing next to S1) because invalid trials (action 0, state 0, very low gate) break the complement. Code the choice as action==1.
skeptic.revised_label: At D2 rises when S1 is reached, falls after choosing a1; at D1 higher after an S2 trial.
